name: Sinew fitness kit (runtime)
purpose: Reusable fitness production assets in the studio runtime: the articulated rig engine, Tibi the mascot in the Cobalt Sculpt style (male and female, front/side/back, muscle activation by role, generated from the Python master in src/fitness/tibi/), a 12-exercise upper-body library, gaits and equipment, anatomy and physiology plates, brand graphics, environments, biomechanics overlays and science charts. Manifest: assets/fitness/manifest.json.
capabilities: kits/fitness/brand.js: Sinew brand palette
studio-rig.js: FK, anchors, two-bone IK, level feet, followers, finite cycles, derived pose attributes

kits/fitness/sculpt.js + sculpt-data.js: Cobalt Sculpt Tibi (male/female, front/side/back, 15 handover poses, activation levels, faces, tops) on the rig, light-fixed crescent shading via the derive hook
src/fitness/tibi/: Python master generator (stdlib) for the Cobalt Sculpt Tibi: review page, standalone SVGs, runtime data (fitness.py sculpt)
kits/fitness/exercises.js: 12 upper-body exercises, curl, squat, calf raise, 3 gaits, flat-plane equipment built from Tibi's joints
kits/fitness/anatomy.js: muscle to sarcomere, cross-section growth, mitochondrion, ATP, heart, lungs, zoom ladder
kits/fitness/graphics.js: logo, cards, badges, citations, environments, biomechanics, charts
kits/fitness/library.js: generated metadata

kits/fitness/tibi3d.js + exercises3d.js: Tibi in real 3D (Three.js r158 vendored): skinned figure, muscles that never pop, free camera, activation by intensity, pure-function-of-time motion tracks; curl, bench press, lateral raise, back squat (and knees blocked), barbell hip thrust, standing and seated calf raise; glute/adductor/soleus, heel lift, chest-frame IK, split-screen views; film3d.js overlays (references/motion-3d.md)

kits/fitness/anatomy3d.js: Tibi's one continuous skin (signed-distance union of cores and muscle volumes), activation gradients on the surface, internal muscles, tendons and bones, cut windows, isolation and skeleton modes (1.9.0)
kits/fitness/scenes3d.js + film3d.js: reusable exercise demo and cutaway scenes; rep HUD, tempo bar, cue card, joint-angle arc, movement trail, EMG sensor and state chip overlays (1.9.0)
1.9.1: exact skin-cache state, IK-to-FK toe reset, ghost-to-normal shader reset, pre-draw onFrame visibility and childless split-view projection cameras
1.9.2: opt-in distance-based core profile sampling; caches separated by profile
1.10.0: integrated distance body is the 3D development default; fan/band anatomy, deep upper-arm brachialis, local morph normals, bounded per-vertex effort, finer skin and a torso-owned top
1.11.0: sloping shoulder envelope, rounded deltoid fans, refined wrist/hand and a separated neutral stance (fig.defaultPose)
1.12.0 (anatomy 1.3.0): no flank or hip ledges; thin serratus sheet, rounded and wrapped pec ends, deep glute medius, rounded leg-tube tops; flank/hip step gate in anatomy3d-check
1.13.0 (Tibi 0.5.0): camera fitting to the posed body and props over a set (stage.fit, T3.fitScene, T3.scene fit option); framing gate in rig3d-check

1.14.0 (anatomy 1.4.0, Tibi 0.6.0): known limits: flat glute fan, shape-weighted effort and subdued cloth tint, solid glute cutaway, female deltoid, shoulder-ridge weights, elbow/knee/hip fold correctives; ponytail follow-through, bench arch (T3.solveArch), one bending sole and foot roll (T3.footRoll, tf key); a gate per fix
1.15.0 (anatomy 1.6.0, Tibi 0.8.0, sculpt 2.2.0): shoulder girdle bones, 18 new 3D exercises and mistake variants, stations.js (layout, exercise card, captionLane, audit)

1.15.1: exercise card keeps chips, cues, tip and swaps at or above 2.6% of the short side (--sn-read-floor); a card that still overflows drops trailing chips to 3, then secondary ones only; fitCard measures leaf content (the flex-grown slot made every card shrink); audit kind card-below-floor with a negative control

1.16.0 (Tibi 0.9.0): motion family 3 on the shoulder girdle: seated dumbbell overhead press, lat pulldown, pull-up, seated cable row, one-arm dumbbell row, each with a mistake variant (lower-back arch, swing-back, short range, trunk rock, torso twist); T3.girdleJoint (the joint the girdle will move to, exact), chest-frame arm solvers, a balance-solved hang, garS hand-roll branch key; rig3d-check measures reach from the moved joint and gates hand-orientation snaps

installation.instructions: Synced into projects with the runtime (studio.py sync/upgrade); load the scripts as the fitness-explainer template does.

compatibility.notes: 1.11 refines shoulder/arm geometry and the neutral stance exposed by fig.defaultPose. Authored-motion defaults, pose keys, palette and 2D art are unchanged. Explicit legacy remains a compatibility reference. Mac production and human G3 remain pending.

licensing.notes: Original workspace code and art; no third-party assets.

security.notes: Runs inside the render browser only.

approval_evidence: 1.12.0, Windows 2026-11-21: flank/hip steps fall from 10.6 (male) / 9.4 and 8.2 (female) to at most 3.2 units per 5; three actual-checker defect controls fail as intended; 59 tests and 40 temporal cases pass; explicit legacy is byte-identical. 1.11.0, Windows 2026-11-20: 59 tests without skips, 40 temporal passes and actual old-orb/flat-root/old-stance defect controls. Same-pose shoulder correction and new neutral stance are separated in the PNGs. All 80 sampled authored pose/bone/prop states and 20 explicit-legacy images remain identical. Hands remain stylised. No Mac or human G3 approval.
